row.proto: void Career_Collect_TeamEntriesByKey(void *out, void *src, uint32_t team_key, void *alloc)
row.notes: myteam-g2: Collects pointers to the 0x58-byte records at src+8..+0x10 whose team key (u8@+0x58, u16@+0x5a) equals team_key into a vector. Used by Career_DeptEvent_Start and Career_GameValue_GetNetWeeklyIncome (team income entries).

verify.notes: V10210 Collects pointers to records matching u8@+0x58/u16@+0x5a, but the source array stride is 0x88 bytes (not 0x58); 0x58 is the key offset.
